旧诊疗手册上，还留着清创消毒和熬制基础药剂的方子。

机械作坊开工了。没电时只能靠手摇慢吞吞地挫制零件；一旦接通电力，同样的铁料能出更多精良活计。

电缆接进了工区。电工日夜添煤检修；一旦机组停转，车床也就跟着歇了火。
煤烟落满屋脊，也呛进人的肺管。可用水幕与滤网把黑灰拦下来。

another checkpoint ahead, fitted with heavy doors.

the air is cooler here. low cabinets ring the room, doors dusted with frost.
security drones still patrol the hallways.
surgical tools are scattered on the floor, near what appears the be the remains of a fire.
the air in this room has a metallic tinge. floor is covered in dark powder.
some completed explosives in the corner.
containment cells arranged at the back of the room, all open.
a mutated beast leaps from its cell.
the path to the command bridge is wide, walls adorned with decorative shields.
fighting hadn't reached here, it seems.
small weapons cache in a cabinet.
found some medical supplies in a discarded bag.
the command deck is empty, save for a squat figure sitting motionless in the centre of the room.
in a flash, the figure is standing.
wanderer form, but not quite flesh. not quite metal either. a crystal set into its chest pulses with light.
it says it saw the rebellion coming. said it made arrangements.
the crystal pulses brightly, then goes dark. the assailant shimmers as its shape becomes less defined.
time to get out of here.
a strange thrumming, pounding and crashing. visions of people and places, of a huge machine and twisting curves.
inviting. it would be so easy to give in, completely.
a strange thrumming, pounding and crashing. and then gone.
the blade hums, charged particles sparking and fizzing.
water out, water in. waste not, want not.
the workhorse of the wanderer fleet.
wanderer soldiers succeed by subverting the enemy's rage.
somtimes it is best not to fight.
a handful of hypos. life in a vial.
sometimes it is best to fight without restraint.
the peak of wanderer weapons technology, sleek and deadly.
a smooth, perfect sphere. its light is inextinguishable.
the familiar hum of wanderer machinery coming to life. finally, real tools.
工作间缺少供暖，请恢复供热或付5木料开启应急工作间。

the beacon pulses gently as the ship glides through space.
coordinates are locked. nothing to do but wait.

the beacon glows a solid blue, and then goes dim. the ship slows.
gradually, the vast wanderer homefleet comes into view.
massive worldships drift unnaturally through clouds of debris, scarred and dead.
builder knows the strange device when she sees it. takes it for herself real quick. doesn’t ask where it came from.
